precondition: non-searchable list; an enabled row has is_current
behaviour: The list opens with its current row selected.
notes: Current-row preselection applies only to non-searchable lists (line 684-691).

precondition: non-searchable list; the current row is disabled
behaviour: The disabled current row is not selected; the first enabled row is selected instead.

precondition: searchable list, or no current row
behaviour: The first enabled row is selected.
notes: No S14 test; is_current is ignored in searchable lists.

precondition: initial_selected_idx set and that row enabled; no row selected yet
behaviour: That row is selected on the first filter pass and the stored index is then consumed.
notes: Set_search_query uses the same path to restore a selection (see the set_search_query row).

precondition: tabs present; initial_tab_id given
behaviour: The tab with that id is active; an unknown or missing id opens the first tab.
notes: Unknown-id fallback is not tested.

precondition: tabs present; no initial_selected_idx; nothing selected after the first filter pass
behaviour: The first enabled row of the active tab is selected with the scroll at the top.
notes: No S14 test for this path.

precondition: title and/or subtitle set
behaviour: The title is bold and the subtitle dim above the rows, with one blank line between the header and the rows.
notes: header_gap defaults to 1 (line 317); inline banners use 0.

precondition: title or subtitle wider than the popup
behaviour: Title and subtitle wrap onto further lines instead of being cut off.
notes: Visible in the 40x16 snapshot (subtitle wraps over three lines).

precondition: the shared header is taller than its area and no search field is visible
behaviour: The last visible header line becomes an elision notice '[… N lines]' (plus a view-all hint when header_view_all_hint is set) instead of silent clipping.
notes: Not a candidate; no S14 test. With the search field visible the header is only clipped.

precondition: footer hint set for the selected row, tab or view
behaviour: The footer shows the selected row's hint (its search hint while on-demand search is open, else its footer_hint, else its secondary action's hint), then the active tab's hint, then the view's hint.
notes: Not a candidate. The shared-menu test asserts only the view-level hint text; the precedence chain is untested.

precondition: footer hint longer than the popup width, or reserve_result_rows set
behaviour: The hint wraps to the popup width; with reserve_result_rows every footer reserves the height of the tallest one so the layout does not jump.
notes: Not a candidate; the reserve part has no S14 test.

precondition: footer_note set and the selected description is not shown below the list
behaviour: The footer note wraps to the popup width under a two-column indent.

precondition: description layout SelectedBelowWhenNarrow and the description column is too narrow
behaviour: The selected row's description is shown dimmed below the list in place of the footer note.
notes: Not a candidate. The picker preset uses HideWhenNarrow, so this path is not used by picker(); config_panel/render.rs uses SelectedBelowWhenNarrow. No S14 test.

precondition: searchable list with SearchMode::Immediate (default)
behaviour: The searchable list opens with its search field showing an empty query and the placeholder in dim text.
notes: Non-searchable lists also start with search_active true, but draw no field.

precondition: search_mode OnDemand
behaviour: The search field stays hidden until the search key opens it.
notes: config_panel/render.rs:487-513 uses OnDemand with '/'.

precondition: initial_search_query given
behaviour: The view opens filtered to that query with the search field open, even in OnDemand mode.
notes: Restores a filter after a parent rebuild.

precondition: searchable list; search field visible (search active)
behaviour: A search line below the header and tabs shows the query, or the dim placeholder when the query is empty.
notes: Empty-searchable snapshot shows 'Type to search branches' above 'no matches'.

precondition: on-demand search open
behaviour: The terminal cursor sits after 'Search › ' and the query, capped one column short of the width.
notes: cursor_pos is None when on-demand search is closed.

precondition: on-demand search binding ('/' in config panel); searchable list in OnDemand mode; search not active; key is the binding and not a chord prefix
behaviour: The search field opens empty and the list's own bindings keep working.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: printable char; searchable list in OnDemand mode; search not active
behaviour: The letter does nothing (not typed, not a shortcut) while list navigation keys still work; a row's secondary key still runs.
notes: Derived from arm order; not tested.

precondition: printable char; search field visible; no earlier arm consumed the key
behaviour: The character is appended to the query and the list re-filters; in a searchable list digits are typed, not used as shortcuts.
notes: tiny_viewports types '2' and asserts the query is '2'.

precondition: printable char with Ctrl or Alt; search field visible; the key is not a bound list action
behaviour: A Ctrl or Alt letter is not typed into the query.
notes: Not tested; bound Ctrl letters (Ctrl-B, Ctrl-F, Ctrl-J, ...) act first.

precondition: C0 control char (Ctrl-P as 0x10, Ctrl-N as 0x0e) with its list action unbound; searchable list; move_up or move_down unbound
behaviour: The key does nothing: it neither moves the cursor nor enters the query.

precondition: C0 control char bound as a list action; searchable list; move_down rebound to Ctrl-P
behaviour: The key performs the bound action (the cursor moves down).
notes: C0 bytes are matched as Ctrl+letter by the keymap (normalisation is outside the S14 files).

precondition: Backspace; search field visible
behaviour: The last character of the query is removed and the list re-filters; with an empty query nothing changes.
notes: Without a search field Backspace is ignored. No S14 test.

precondition: list.cancel (Esc); on-demand search open
behaviour: Esc closes the search field and clears its query; the picker stays open.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: list.accept (Enter); on-demand search open
behaviour: Enter accepts the selected row as the primary action even though the search field is open.
backend_effect: effect as the accept row: row actions and on_accept_key
notes: Same accept path as the accept row.

precondition: on-demand search open
behaviour: Ctrl+C closes the on-demand search and is handled; the picker stays open.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: on-demand search closed; allow_cancel false
behaviour: Ctrl+C is not handled, so the parent decides what happens.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: list.cancel (Esc) or ctrl-c; on-demand search closed; allow_cancel true
behaviour: The picker is cancelled: the on_cancel callback runs and the view completes as Cancelled.
notes: The test binds cancel to Space on a checkbox row: it asserts Cancelled, the toggle left on and no action sent; no on_cancel callback is set and the default Esc binding is not asserted.

precondition: list.cancel (Esc); allow_cancel false
behaviour: The cancel key does nothing.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: list.cancel (Esc); immediate search with a non-empty query
behaviour: Esc cancels the picker without first clearing the query.
notes: Derived from arm order; untested.

precondition: Space; selected row has an enabled toggle; search field hidden, or Immediate with an empty query
behaviour: The row flips on or off and one save is counted as pending.
notes: No S14 test asserts the positive path; the Space tests assert the negatives.

precondition: Space; immediate search with a non-empty query
behaviour: Space is appended to the query and does not toggle the row.

precondition: Space; immediate search with an empty query; selected row has a toggle_placeholder and no toggle
behaviour: Space does nothing.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: search_toggle_key (non-text key, unbound); selected row has an enabled toggle and the key is not a bound list action; any query state
behaviour: The selected row toggles even while the query is non-empty (unlike Space).
notes: Deliberate per the field doc (line 238). Positive path untested.

precondition: search_toggle_key bound also as a list action (Tab bound to move_down); searchable list with search_toggle_key
behaviour: The list action wins: the cursor moves and no toggle fires.

precondition: list.move_up / list.move_down (Up, Ctrl-P, Ctrl-K, k / Down, Ctrl-N, Ctrl-J, j); list has rows
behaviour: The selection moves one visible row and wraps from the last row to the first and back.
backend_effect: on_selection_changed(actual index) when the actual row changed
notes: Wrap is not asserted in the S14 file (scroll_state tests cover it).

precondition: list.move_up / list.move_down; the next row in that direction is disabled
behaviour: The selection skips disabled rows; if every row is disabled it stops on a disabled row.
notes: No S14 test for arrow skipping (only page and End are tested).

precondition: list.page_up / list.page_down (PageUp, Ctrl-B / PageDown, Ctrl-F); list has rows
behaviour: The selection moves by the number of rows painted last frame (max_visible_rows before the first render) and stops at the first or last row without wrapping.
backend_effect: on_selection_changed(actual index) when the actual row changed
notes: Before any render the step is max_visible_rows (8 by default, popup_consts.rs:14). The browser test asserts visible < 24 and PageDown lands on index = visible.

precondition: list.page_up / list.page_down; the clamped landing row is disabled
behaviour: PageDown moves to the nearest enabled row forward, else backward; PageUp does the reverse; no wrap; the selection stays put when none exists.
notes: The stays-put fallback is not tested.

precondition: list.jump_top / list.jump_bottom (Home / End); list has rows
behaviour: The selection goes to the first or last row; a disabled landing row moves to the nearest enabled row (forward then backward from the top, backward then forward from the bottom) with no wrap.
backend_effect: on_selection_changed(actual index) when the actual row changed
notes: The keymap test rebinds jump_top to Ctrl-A and jump_bottom to Ctrl-E; the skip test presses End and Home is not tested.

precondition: a list binding rebound in the keymap (page_down = Ctrl-D); keymap rebinds the action
behaviour: The new key performs the action and the default key (PageDown) no longer does.

precondition: list.move_left / list.move_right (Left, Ctrl-H / Right, Ctrl-L); the view has tabs
behaviour: The active tab moves to the previous or next tab and wraps at the ends.
notes: With no tabs the keys do nothing (tabs_enabled guard).

precondition: tab switch (consequence of move_left / move_right); a tab switch happens
behaviour: The selection moves to the new tab's current row, else its first enabled row, with the scroll reset.
backend_effect: on_selection_changed(actual index), fired even if the row did not move
notes: Unlike moves, switch_tab fires the callback unconditionally (line 857). The current-row choice applies to non-searchable tabbed lists.

precondition: tab switch; search_items is empty
behaviour: The search query is cleared on tab switch.
notes: With search_items non-empty the query is kept.

precondition: printable char / paste (query non-empty); search_items non-empty and query non-empty
behaviour: The flat search_items replace the active tab's rows across all tabs.
notes: active_items (581-589) is not a candidate; no S14 test.

precondition: query edit (typing, Backspace, paste); search field visible
behaviour: Each edit re-filters; the scroll resets only when the edit switches between flat search items and tab items.

precondition: query edit (filter pass); searchable list with a non-empty query
behaviour: Only rows whose search_value contains the query (case-insensitive) stay visible; rows without a search_value disappear.
notes: The constructor doc (line 466-470) warns that such rows vanish on purpose.

precondition: query edit (filter pass); the selection is on a visible row whose visible row number still exists after the filter
behaviour: The filter keeps the selection at the same visible row number; if that row is disabled, the first enabled visible row is chosen.
notes: No S14 test asserts the kept-row-number rule.

precondition: query edit (filter pass); the visible row number no longer exists after the filter
behaviour: The selection moves to the previously selected row when it is still visible and enabled, else to the first enabled visible row.
backend_effect: on_selection_changed(actual index) if the actual row changed

precondition: query edit (filter pass); every visible row is disabled
behaviour: The selection lands on the first visible row, which is disabled and cannot be accepted.
notes: Risk: the highlight sits on an unacceptable row; no test.

precondition: no row was selected before the first filter pass; on_selection_changed set; an enabled row exists
behaviour: The callback fires once at construction with the first selected row's actual index.
notes: Risk: a preview consumer fires on open; no test.

precondition: query edit or filter pass; on_selection_changed set; filter changes the actual selected row
behaviour: The callback fires with the new actual index (live preview).
notes: The theme picker uses this for live preview.

precondition: list.move_up / move_down / page / jump; the actual selected row did not change
behaviour: on_selection_changed does not fire.

precondition: (parent calls set_search_query); any
behaviour: The query is set and the search field opens; the selection is kept on the same item when the item source does not change, else it resets.
notes: Caller: bottom_pane/mod.rs:1595 (keymap_setup/picker_tests.rs:39 is a test).

precondition: (parent reads search_query); searchable list
behaviour: The inherent search_query() reports the query only while the field is visible; the trait method reports it whenever the list is searchable.

precondition: filtered list is empty (no matches, or an empty list)
behaviour: A dim italic 'no matches' line replaces the rows and the search line stays visible.
notes: Also shown for empty non-searchable lists.

precondition: list.accept (Enter); no row selected (no matches, or an empty list)
behaviour: The view cancels: the on_cancel callback runs and the view completes as Cancelled.
notes: An empty non-searchable list takes the same branch (not tested).

precondition: list.accept (Enter); selected row enabled and has actions
behaviour: Its actions run in order, then its on_accept_key with the activating key.
backend_effect: action(AppEventSender) for each action; on_accept_key(AppEventSender, key)
notes: on_accept_key is not exercised by any S14 test.

precondition: list.accept (Enter); accepted row has dismiss_on_select
behaviour: After its actions the view completes as Accepted and closes.

precondition: list.accept (Enter); accepted row has dismiss_parent_on_child_accept and not dismiss_on_select
behaviour: The view stays open and sets dismiss_after_child_accept so the parent picker closes too.
notes: Used by chatwidget/model_popups.rs:671 and quick_dials.rs:442. No S14 test.

precondition: list.accept (Enter); accepted row has neither dismiss flag
behaviour: The actions run and the view stays open.
notes: The stays-open part is not asserted; automatic_shortcuts_stop_at_nine asserts only the last-selected index.

precondition: list.accept (Enter); selected row is disabled (is_disabled or disabled_reason)
behaviour: Nothing happens: no action, no dismissal, and the row is not recorded as last selected.
notes: Silent no-op. The secondary-key variant is tested (see the disabled secondary-key row).

precondition: row secondary key; enabled row; search field hidden or key not plain text; on-demand closed
behaviour: The secondary action runs instead of the primary actions and the view dismisses by the same dismiss_on_select rule.

precondition: row secondary key typed into an open search; searchable list; search field visible; key is plain text
behaviour: The key is typed into the query and the secondary action does not run.

precondition: row secondary key on a disabled row; row disabled
behaviour: Nothing happens: no action and no completion.

precondition: printable accept key (accept list includes 'z'); searchable list; search field visible
behaviour: The printable key accepts the selected row instead of being typed into the query.
notes: The accept arm precedes the typing arm, so a bound printable key can no longer be typed.

precondition: list.accept (Enter) on a checkbox_toggle row; enabled checkbox row
behaviour: Enter flips the checkbox (sends the toggle action), records the row as last-selected, and neither runs actions nor dismisses.
notes: No S14 test presses Enter on a checkbox row; configured_cancel_binding_takes_precedence_over_space_toggle has a checkbox row but presses Space.

precondition: digit 1-9; non-searchable list with auto_number_shortcuts; a row with that ordinal exists
behaviour: The k-th enabled non-child row is selected and accepted; disabled and child rows do not take a number; '0' does nothing.
notes: '0' returns None (line 887-889); untested.

precondition: row display_shortcut key or child_label letter; non-searchable list; row enabled
behaviour: The row is selected and accepted like a digit.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: digit 1-9; auto_number_shortcuts false
behaviour: Digits do nothing; only each row's explicit shortcut acts.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: row shortcut with require_explicit_confirmation; non-searchable list
behaviour: The row is highlighted but not accepted; the accept key confirms it.
backend_effect: on_selection_changed(actual index) if the row changed
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: auto_number_shortcuts set; row enabled and non-child
behaviour: Enabled non-child rows are numbered 1, 2, 3 in order; a disabled row shows a blank gutter (or its disabled_gutter_marker) and a child row shows its letter.

precondition: row number beyond 9
behaviour: Rows past nine show a blank gutter, so only the first nine rows carry a number.
notes: The test does not press a digit for row 10.

precondition: searchable list
behaviour: Rows carry no numbers or shortcut labels; the gutter is only the selection marker.
notes: Digits go to the query in searchable lists.

precondition: auto_number_shortcuts false
behaviour: Each row shows its own shortcut label instead of an ordinal.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: row is_current
behaviour: The row name gets a ' (current)' suffix.
notes: Not asserted in the S14 tests.

precondition: row has a toggle, or a toggle_placeholder and no toggle
behaviour: A toggle row shows '[*] ' when on and '[ ] ' when off ('[x] ' for a checkbox row); a placeholder shows its text in that spot.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: (parent polls selection_toggle_states); row has a toggle and pending saves > 0
behaviour: The view reports each row's on state and pending count so the parent can show in-flight saves.
notes: Consumer: bottom_pane/mod.rs:1693-1700.

precondition: a save finishes for a row
behaviour: complete_selection_toggle(index) lowers that row's pending count by one and never below zero.
notes: Called from chatwidget/config_panel.rs:153.

precondition: (parent reads completion); completion set by accept or cancel
behaviour: The view reports completion (Accepted or Cancelled) and the bottom pane removes it.

precondition: (parent reads presentation); any
behaviour: The view reports its presentation (Inline by default) to the bottom pane.
notes: Passthrough; no S14 test.

precondition: any (parent reads prefer_esc); any
behaviour: The view asks to see Esc before the bottom pane handles it.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: any (keymap context); any
behaviour: Keys resolve in the List keymap context, so the configured list bindings apply.
notes: Exercised through the remapped-binding tests.

precondition: any while the app is disconnected; allow_input_when_disconnected false (default)
behaviour: The view keeps taking keys only when allow_input_when_disconnected is set.
notes: The decision is made by the bottom pane; this view only reports it.

precondition: (parent reads view_id); view_id set
behaviour: The view reports its view_id so the bottom pane can find or replace it.
notes: Passthrough.

precondition: (parent reads selected_index); any
behaviour: The view reports its selected actual row index.
notes: Passthrough.

precondition: (parent reads active_tab_id); tabs present
behaviour: The view reports the active tab's id, or none without tabs.

precondition: parent reads take_last_selected_index (after accept or shortcut); an accept or digit/shortcut selected a row
behaviour: Returns the actual index of the last accepted row once, then clears it.
notes: Read by approval_overlay.rs:613, user_verification.rs:184, actionable_banner.rs:284 and config_panel/input.rs:146.

precondition: unhandled key (no arm matches); any
behaviour: The key is dropped with no callback and no change.

precondition: search field visible
behaviour: The pasted text is whitespace-normalised (trimmed, runs of whitespace and newlines collapsed to single spaces), appended to the query, the list re-filters, and the paste is consumed.
notes: 'f' then paste 'eature/paste-support\n' gives 'feature/paste-support'.

precondition: pasted text is whitespace only
behaviour: Nothing changes and the paste is not consumed.

precondition: search field not visible (non-searchable list, or on-demand search closed)
behaviour: The paste is not consumed and the query does not change.
notes: No S14 test.

precondition: row_display Wrapped (default); name or description longer than its column
behaviour: The text wraps onto continuation lines aligned under the option text.

precondition: row_display SingleLine
behaviour: Each row takes one line; overflow is cut with an ellipsis; height reserves one line per row up to max_visible_rows.

precondition: name_column_width set
behaviour: The name column is at least that wide, moving the description right.

precondition: name column plus gap would take more than 70% of the width
behaviour: The description column is capped at 70% of the content width so descriptions keep at least 30%.
notes: Not tested. Doc at line 150 says 'at least 30%'.

precondition: col_width_mode AutoVisible (default)
behaviour: The description column is sized from the visible rows, so it can move when the list scrolls.
notes: The test only renders the snapshot; the shift is visible in the .snap file.

precondition: col_width_mode AutoAllRows (picker preset)
behaviour: The description column is sized from all rows, so it does not move while scrolling.

precondition: three numbered options; widths 60 to 90
behaviour: All three numbered rows stay visible at every width from 60 to 90.
notes: Asserts the substring '3.' at each width.

precondition: width 24 with descriptions
behaviour: All rows stay visible at width 24; the description wraps or hides instead.
notes: The snapshot test has no assertion of its own.

precondition: three options with descriptions at width 80
behaviour: Numbered rows with a description column are laid out at width 80.
notes: Snapshot-only; no assertion.

precondition: half-width katakana with sound marks at widths 20 and 24
behaviour: Rows are measured in display columns so the descriptions align.
notes: Oracle is the test; the measuring helper is in selection_popup_common.rs.

precondition: the list is taller than its area
behaviour: The list shows a window that keeps the selected row inside it and scrolls when the selection moves.

precondition: rows are hidden above or below and the surface has reserved indicator rows
behaviour: A ↑ shows on the first list row when rows are hidden above and a ↓ on the last when rows are hidden below, in an accent colour matched to the background.
notes: Markers need reserved indicator rows and a list at least 3 rows high (picker_style.rs:55); tight heights draw none.

precondition: picker_surface Panel
behaviour: The Panel paints the shaded message background behind the list and adds one spare line at the bottom; Terminal keeps the terminal background.
notes: The test asserts the background colour per surface.

precondition: a row is selected
behaviour: The selected row (marked '›') is painted with the selection background across the full width.

precondition: a disabled row is selected
behaviour: A disabled row is dimmed and never takes the selection colour.
notes: Not asserted in S14 tests; the exclusion is in code.

precondition: row has disabled_reason
behaviour: The row shows '(disabled)' after its name; its description reads 'desc (disabled: reason)', or 'disabled: reason' with no description; the Picker preset shows the reason alone with no description.

precondition: picker preset (HideWhenNarrow 24): fewer than 24 columns remain for the description
behaviour: The description column and its reason are hidden; only the name and '(disabled)' tag remain.
notes: Seen in the 40x16 snapshot; not asserted.

precondition: the view's own height is requested
behaviour: The view asks for the lines its header, tabs, search line, rows (capped at max_visible_rows, at least one), footer and stacked side content need, plus one for a Panel.
notes: Only the single-line height is asserted.

precondition: reserve_result_rows set
behaviour: The result area stays at max_visible_rows and the header and footer reserve the tallest tab or item height, so filtering does not shift the layout.
notes: Not tested in S14.

precondition: the active tab has its own header
behaviour: That header replaces the shared header while the tab is active.
notes: Not tested in S14.

precondition: the view has tabs
behaviour: A one-row tab strip shows each tab label with the active tab filled; hidden tabs on either side are marked ‹ or ›.

precondition: browser at 60x18 (picker_tests)
behaviour: Rows that fit are painted; the selected row keeps its full background.

precondition: tiny area (0x0, 1x1, 4x1, 12x3, 40x8)
behaviour: Rendering in a tiny area leaves the query and selection unchanged; a zero-area render draws nothing; the 80x24 view renders the same afterwards.

behaviour: The header, tabs, search line and footer remain visible; the footer hint yields first when tight.

precondition: browser shrinks from 60x24 to 60x13 with the selection on row 7

precondition: theme picker; side-by-side layout
behaviour: The theme picker sets preserve_side_content_bg so the diff preview keeps its background.
notes: Consumer parameter from theme_picker (outside the S14 file set); asserted here.

precondition: theme picker at 94x35 with a home directory
behaviour: The theme picker shows 'Move up/down to live preview themes' as its subtitle fallback.

precondition: side layout: Half or Fixed side width fits and the list keeps at least 40 columns and the side width is at least side_content_min_width

behaviour: The same blank-cell clearing holds when the view draws away from the origin.

precondition: side-by-side and preserve_side_content_bg true
